sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Guard on site and signed in. Debriefing.
Standing by due to weather conditions.
McDonald's Queen Street called about a male in a red polo with black sleeves being aggressive, who stole their bell. Last known location heading down Queen Street passing Farmers. Heading to respond.
Couldn't find the POI. Heading back to see if we can get footage.
Manager will be in at 11:00; hopefully we can retrieve CCTV by then. Standing by for security presence.
Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards High Street.
High Street all clear, no issues to report. Heading towards Chancery Square.
Standing by for security presence at Chancery Square and to seek shelter from the weather.
Heading back on shift towards Fort Street.
Welfare check completed, no issues to report. Standing by seeking shelter:
Heading to check on Gore Street.
Welfare check on Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Custom Mart and Coffee Club all clear. Arrived at Britomart McDonald's.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. Standing by for security presence. Weather starting to improve.
Heading to check on Lower Albert Street before heading up Albert Street.
All clear at Woolworths and Aotea Gifts. Heading up Albert Street.
Welfare check on Albert Mart, no issues to report.
Welfare check on Cathedral area, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards the corner of Victoria and Federal Street.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed, Casa Victoria, Coffee Club and Amelia Cafe, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Victoria Street full sweep complete, all clear. Heading up upper Queen Street.
Welfare checks completed, no issues to report:
Check-in at corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield / Library, no issues. Heading back down Lorne Street towards High Street.
Lorne Street and High Street all clear, no issues.
Freyberg Square and Chancery Square no issues; on standby showing security presence.
Freyberg and Chancery Square all clear, no issues to report.
Responding to a call from Nike store regarding an individual stealing; advised the POI was wearing white.

Arrived at store; POI had already left. Staff advised the individual keeps shoving stock down her pants. Will keep an eye out for the POI; no further issues at Nike at this time. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Check-in at Hour Glass, Chemist Warehouse, Kathmandu, Macpac, no issues to report.
Vulcan Lane all clear, no issues to report.
Conducted a sweep at Imperial Lane, all clear, no issues.
Queen Street full sweep complete, no issues to report.
Welfare check Britomart McDonald's, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; on standby showing security presence.
Commercial Bay all clear; welfare checks H&M, Britomart McDonald's, Mecca, Aotea Gifts, all clear. Heading back up Queen Street.
On standby at Faradays showing presence due to a queue in front of the shop.
No issues at Faradays, heading up Queen Street. Rerouted back to Fort Street to do welfare checks.
Welfare checks KFC, Walker and Hall, Evan's, Right Track, Tribe, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Haven Mart, no issues to report. Heading up High Street.
Welfare checks Hotel Debrett, Corner Bar, no issues to report.
High Street all clear, no issues.
Check-in at Freyberg and Chancery Square; a few vagrants hanging around Freyberg Square but causing no issues.
Welfare check Metropolis Hotel, no issues to report.
Responded to a call from Cotton On regarding a couple arguing in the store.
Arrived on site; staff advised the couple had left but had been acting suspiciously in store. No further issues.
Check-in at Recycle Boutique, Lumi Cafe, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Elliot Street, Darby Street and Wilson Carpark — a group of vagrants talking aggressively to themselves and being loud around families walking by.
The group has calmed down; no further issues. Heading back to HQ for refreshments.
Heading back out on patrols. Heading up Victoria Street.
Welfare checks with the guard at Woolworths, no issues to report.
Check-in at Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed, no issues to report.
Check-in at St Patrick's Cathedral church, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, welfare checks Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Bakery, Chemist Warehouse, all clear. Heading back up Wyndham to sweep the rest of Albert Street.
Welfare check Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Welfare checks conducted at Aotea Gifts shop and Woolworths, no issues to report. Heading back up Queen Street to HQ for break.
Check-in at Britomart McDonald's, no issues.
Break ended; on standby awaiting changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:00)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing patrol up upper Queen Street.
Welfare check on Queen Street McDonald's, all clear, continuing patrol up upper Queen Street.
Upper Queen Street all clear. Arrived at Aotea Square commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square all clear, no issues, continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Arrived at Elliot Stables commencing welfare checks, maintaining presence in the area.
Patrolling down Elliot Street, welfare check Elliot Car Park, Domino's Pizza, Indian Buffet, Fresh Market, all clear, patrolling down Darby Street.
Received a response call from Cotton On regarding 2 males lying down in front of the store.
Arrived at location; 1 male seen unconscious, now wide awake, was asked to move from the premises.
2 vagrants in front of the store asked to move.
Arrived at Wyndham Street; welfare check on Wyndham Street, standing by showing presence.
Arrived at Fort Street commencing full sweep, then to HQ to charge Ops Phone (15%).
Full sweep all clear, no issues, continuing patrol.
Arrived at HQ charging Ops Phone (8%), awaiting response calls.
Welfare check on Noel Leeming, Glassons, Kathmandu, all clear, no issues.
Continuing Alpha Route towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Britomart; welfare check on Britomart McDonald's, standing by showing presence.
A group of individuals being searched by Police — possibly a group with stolen goods. (Video on file.)
Commencing full sweep of Britomart and Commercial Bay.
Full sweep all clear, no issues, continuing patrol towards Chancery Square whilst conducting welfare checks on the bottom of Fort Street.
Welfare check High Street Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square commencing full sweep.
Standing by at Chancery Square homeless shelter, giving essentials out, showing presence.
All clear, no further issues, continuing patrol.
Standing by at Chancery Square again, helping out and showing presence.
Received a response call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding vagrants in front of the store who were asked to vacate the premises and wouldn't comply.
Patrolling through High Street down Victoria Street.
Vagrant sleeping on the side of the HQ doorway removed safely.
Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's; a group of vagrants sitting in front have now left. Standing by showing presence in case they return.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear, no further issues, heading back to HQ to do floor checks.
Floor checks all clear, no issues.
Heading to HQ to charge Ops Phone (3%).
Arrived at HQ charging Ops Phone.
Commencing patrol down Queen Street towards High Street.
Patrolling down High Street towards Chancery Square.
Arrived at Chancery Square commencing a full sweep.
All clear, no issues, continuing patrol down High Street.
Welfare check on Haven Mart, all clear, no issues, continuing patrol down Jean Batten Place towards Fort Lane.
Arrived at Fort Lane, standing by showing presence.
Continuing patrol down Fort Street towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on Britomart McDonald's, standing by.
Commencing full sweep of Commercial Bay, making sure the area is safe.
All clear, no further issues, continuing patrol towards Quay Street.
Patrolling towards HQ; received a call from the CBD cleaner.
Arrived at HQ, let the CBD cleaner in, continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Patrolling up Victoria Street, down Albert Street towards Customs Street.
Patrolling lower Albert Street whilst conducting a welfare check on Woolworths.
All clear, no issues, commencing patrol up Queen Street.
Patrolling back to HQ to take 30-minute break.
Welfare check on Wyndham Street, standing by maintaining presence.
All clear, no issues, continuing patrol towards HQ.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standing by at HQ charging Ops Phone (8%).
Full sweep of Durham Street, all clear, no issues, continuing patrol down towards Wyndham Street.
Wyndham Street check-in at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear; customers at the hotdog stand all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on minimart Shortland Street / Mothership; on standby showing presence.
Mothership all clear, no issues to report, continuing patrol.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store, Queen Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Britomart McDonald's, no issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep all clear, just a group of minors hanging around but causing no issues.
Continuing patrol on Quay Street; welfare check-in at Reign and Pour, standing by showing presence.
Reign and Pour all clear, no issues.
Big crowd outside Andrew Andrew's; on standby showing security presence.
All clear, no issues to report, crowd has died down.
Welfare check Danny Doolans / marina guards, no issues to report.
Went back to Andrew Andrew's due to the bar being busy with big groups partying there.
Andrew Andrew's quietened down a bit, no issues to report. Heading down Quay Street to check on Reign and Pour.
On standby outside Reign and Pour showing presence.
Reign and Pour packing up and closing down, no issues to report. Heading up Albert Street.
Welfare check Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Victoria Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone.
On standby at HQ charging Ops Phone (7%).
Received a response call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding a vagrant refusing to leave the store.
Arrived at location; tried multiple times to wake the vagrant, who did not respond and whose pants were halfway down.
Managed to get him up and asked him to leave; he complied. Standing by showing presence.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear, no further issues, heading back to HQ to standby for calls and charge Ops Phone.
Check-in at 77 Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Check-in at St Patrick's Cathedral church, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Check-in at Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, welfare checks conducted at Jo and Joes, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ, on standby for any calls, having break and awaiting shift changeover.
